headline: A cyberattack breached an unclassified CIA system as Britain's cyber agency reported a marked rise in AI-assisted intrusions.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers now hand whole intrusion stages to software, and Cairn agents reached root in minutes, so defenders lose the days that patching assumes.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Cairn Agents Reach Root in 11 Minutes

emerging_trends.text: Breaches at an unclassified CIA system, the European Commission, and Colorado's myColorado app show public digital services drawing sustained attacker attention.
Radware, Rackspace, and N-able breaches handed attackers customer keys and secrets, so one vendor intrusion cascades into every downstream environment.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Radware Breach Exposes Customer Cloud Keys

topics.title: NCSC Flags Marked Rise in AI Attacks
topics.latest_developments: Britain's National Cyber Security Centre reported a marked rise since September in AI-assisted attacks, and attackers compromised Check Point security management servers at 22 organizations.
topics.why_it_matters: The agency says AI lifts attackers' speed, scale, and persistence, shrinking the window defenders get to spot and contain an intrusion.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The Check Point campaign ran from 99 IP addresses and chained multiple vulnerabilities, hitting organizations across several industries and countries.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The European Commission confirmed that its October AI-assisted intrusion stole names and email addresses of EU Academy users.

sources.title: UK cyber agency seeing 'marked rise' in AI-driven attacks

topics.title: Cairn Agents Reach Root in 11 Minutes
topics.latest_developments: Dark Reading reported that a China-nexus actor's Cairn agents moved from finding the MONAI Label zero-day to root access in 11 minutes at East Asian universities.
topics.why_it_matters: Agentic tooling collapses the gap between flaw discovery and full compromise to minutes, far inside most patch and detection cycles.

details.label: What to do
details.text: CISA added the MONAI Label flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog Monday. Patch the medical imaging platform and block unauthenticated file writes outside its storage folder.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: Amazon says the agents found and exploited the zero-day with little human input, and the same framework now serves defenders.

sources.title: AI Agents Zip From Flaw Discovery to Root Access in 11 Minutes

topics.title: CISA Flags Exploited N-able MailAssure Flaw
topics.latest_developments: CISA gave federal civilian agencies until Thanksgiving to patch N-able MailAssure flaw CVE-2026-134624, a server-side request forgery rated 9.3 and under active exploitation.
topics.why_it_matters: The bug sits in the email filtering cloud N-able runs for managed service providers, handing attackers a route to internal systems behind that service.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: N-able found the flaw while investigating the breach of its Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Apply the N-able patch and audit high-level API accounts.

details.label: What's next
details.text: CISA added three more exploited flaws Tuesday: Idunno AntiCsrf CVE-2026-131914, Drupal core CVE-2026-132165, and Optimizely Web Experimentation CVE-2026-132224.

topics.title: Norway Names Equinor in Azure Token Hunt

topics.why_it_matters: Stolen gateway credentials reach the backend systems an API fronts, turning one cloud flaw into access across Norwegian energy operations and other sectors.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Microsoft closed the flaw in Azure API Management Classic tiers. Rotate every secret, named value, and subscription key stored in the service.

details.label: Yes, but
details.text: The National Security Authority says it remains uncertain how the actor exploited the vulnerability.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Train help desks and staff to refuse credential entry and login approvals requested by phone. Okta's cluster O-UNC-053 has run campaigns since March 2026.

topics.title: OpenAI and Cisco Ship Shirudo Shield
topics.latest_developments: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime that lets AI agents write dynamic eBPF controls blocking exploit behavior with no restart.
topics.why_it_matters: Testing and deploying a Linux patch takes days or weeks, and the vulnerable service stays exposed the whole time.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Teams running exposed Linux services can deploy a shield that blocks the specific behavior a vulnerability depends on while they test the vendor fix.

details.label: Yes, but
details.text: The tool is not yet production-ready, SecurityWeek reports.

topics.latest_developments: A cyberattack breached an unclassified Central Intelligence Agency system, a source told the Associated Press.
topics.why_it_matters: Unclassified networks carry personnel, contracting, and administrative records that help an adversary map the agency's people and operations.

details.label: Yes, but
details.text: The source did not identify the compromised information or the party responsible.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Colorado said a cyberattack took down its myColorado app and likely exposed data on 150,000 residents who use it for digital identification and state services.

topics.title: Broadcom Patches New Critical vCenter Flaw
topics.latest_developments: Broadcom patched 23 vulnerabilities across VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer, among them CVE-2026-123903, an authentication bypass rated 9.8.
topics.why_it_matters: vCenter runs the virtualization layer under most enterprise data centers, and a China-linked group exploited a separate vCenter bypass as a zero-day starting in September 2026.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The critical bypass sits in the VMware Directory Service, vmdir. Other critical bugs in the batch allow code execution on ESX hosts.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Patch vCenter first, then work through the remaining products. Pull management interfaces off the internet edge.

sources.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities

topics.title: Radware Breach Exposes Customer Cloud Keys
topics.latest_developments: Radware said attackers reached some customers' account details and cloud access keys through an internal Cloud Web Application Firewall management API the company left exposed online.
topics.why_it_matters: Those keys open the cloud environments the firewall protects, so a breach at the security vendor becomes a breach at every customer whose keys moved.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Rotate cloud access keys and account credentials tied to Radware Cloud WAF, and review cloud logs for access from unfamiliar addresses.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: Rackspace is shutting down its Spot cloud platform after a breach reached customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets, giving customers until December 8, 2026 to migrate.

sources.title: Radware discloses breach exposing customer cloud access keys
Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security breach

topics.title: Volant Manticore Backdoors Cyprus Telecom Networks
topics.latest_developments: Researchers disclosed Volant Manticore, a previously undocumented Iran-aligned espionage group that hit telecommunications companies, airlines, and critical infrastructure in Cyprus with the KuboShell backdoor.
topics.why_it_matters: KuboShell runs command and control over the InterPlanetary File System, so defenses tuned to malicious domains and IP addresses miss the channel.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Hunt for InterPlanetary File System gateway traffic leaving servers, and look for Homa, the post-compromise framework the group reimplemented and deploys after access.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: The China-aligned Webworm group rebuilt SoftEther VPN from source to strip the artifacts that expose it to defenders, Dark Reading reported.

sources.title: Iran-Aligned Volant Manticore Uses IPFS-Based KuboShell Backdoor in Espionage Campaigns
Webworm APT Slithers Into Networks With Customized SoftEther VPN

around_teams.why_it_matters: A Thanksgiving-weekend afternoon kickoff on a streaming service changes how Pittsburgh fans watch a game that shapes the AFC North race.

team_usa.title: United States Lands 2028 Copa América
team_usa.latest_developments: The 2028 Copa América will be played in the United States, the second straight edition staged there, ESPN reported Tuesday, November 24.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The United States men's national team gets another senior continental tournament at home, two years after hosting the 2026 World Cup.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: The tournament comes to the United States for the third time in 12 years. ESPN argued the arrangement robs South America of its own competition.

team_usa.title: Pochettino May Tap USMNT Players at United
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN examined Tuesday, November 24, which United States men's national team players Mauricio Pochettino could sign at Manchester United, where a 4-0 loss to Liverpool opened his tenure.
team_usa.why_it_matters: Moves to Old Trafford would push American internationals into a Premier League relegation fight midway through the World Cup cycle.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: ESPN reported Manchester United must spend about 150 million pounds in January or risk losing 300 million pounds to relegation.
